senses.gloss: (בִּלָּק Ar.) pr. n. m. Billak, in conjunction with חִילָּק, חִלָּק, fictitious names for any men (similar to our ‘Tom, Dick & Harry’).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 19a:3">Ḥull. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אנא לא ח׳ וכ׳</he> I know no Ḥillak and no Billak (I know of no authorities or individual opinions), I only know a tradition.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:12">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ וב׳ אכלי להו</he> (margin in Ms. M. <he>חלק בלק</he>) shall Ḥ. a. B. (any persons indiscriminately) enjoy it?
